title: ConflictRecord
description: Two agents proposing incompatible outcomes (contradictory canonical names, contradictory severity) per .claude/rules/agent-orchestration.md. Consumer: ops.mjs conflict open, then ops.mjs quorum vote/resolve; the completion gate's no-open-conflicts check (gate-engine.mjs, via .claude/gates/completion.json) BLOCKS mission completion while this record's status is OPEN, until quorum resolve flips it to RESOLVED with a linked decision-record id.
